responsibility: Defines the TyTy unification rule visitors used by Rust type checking to merge two resolved types into a compatible result. The header introduces BaseRules, which performs the common double-dispatch unification workflow, handles param/placeholder/projection resolution, propagates reference ids through the unified type, and writes back resolved inference variables into TypeCheckContext, then provides specialized rule classes for the concrete TyTy kinds—tuples, ADTs, functions, arrays, references, pointers, parameters, placeholders, dynamic trait objects, primitives, and others—each encoding the kind-specific compatibility, mutability, bound, and inference behavior used by BaseType::unify.
